used_dialogues: I love you. Forever starts today.
I love you too, my forever.
Sign here. The contract begins today.
Just business. No feelings allowed ever.
Rule one: Never fall in love.
Agreed. We are just partners in name.
Why does her smile hurt so much?
He looks at me like a stranger.
I have a date. Ignore me.
Who is she? Why are you lying?
She thinks I’m with someone else.
Here. Sign the divorce papers now.
You think I love her? It’s you!
Did he just say... it’s me?
Keep singing or I steal them.
He loves my strawberry juice.
Why are you blushing like that?
Please do not notice my face.
I saved you the front seat.
Is this how feelings start?
Stay close, it is raining.
His jacket smells like rain and safety.
Let us make this official today.
I never wanted anyone else.
Do not change your mind yet.
Waiting is harder than I thought.
I am ready when you are.
He waited for me all this time.
Marry me, my childhood neighbor.
Yes, a thousand times yes.
